name: Nozokibara Ryouta
source:
Descendant of a famous bloodline of peeping experts. 

In Shin Nozokima:
He is trying to stop being a voyeur, but when he finds that residence where he started living is full of holes and that the residents there have a lot of secrets, he can't keep his instincts back.

In Shin Nozokima 2:
He still lives in the same place, but it's now a residence for students and teachers. His body is starting to feel weird. 
[spoiler]Some powers are awakening in him, like x-ray vision to see though clothes, the ability to detect the pleasure spot in a woman body or being able to stimulate it without touching it.[/spoiler]
